text: Published extents/reservations shall fit their regions and match emitted code. Single-agent profiles shall have zero synchronization/history charges; extra tracking shall fit existing limits without changing reserved-zero fields or private record layouts. A different multi-agent runtime shall define its own capacities/protocol/progress.
